attributes.title: ASCA 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The American School Counselor Association holds its 2027 Annual Conference July 17 to 20, 2027, at the Greater Columbus Convention Center in Columbus, Ohio. ASCA says registration and hotel booking open in February 2027, and the featured speakers are still to be announced.

Early rates apply from February 1 to March 1, 2027. They are $449 for members, $349 for student and retired members and $649 for non-members. Afterwards the rates rise to $499, $399 and $699. A one-day pass costs $219, or $239 after March 1.

ASCA says attendees can earn CEUs, contact hours or graduate credit. The approving bodies and total hours for 2027 are not published yet, so school counselors should check with their state licensing or certification board.
